quote: Every driver of a vehicle approaching a stop intersection indicated by a stop sign shall stop before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection or, if there is no crosswalk, shall stop at a clearly marked stop line, or if none, then at the point nearest the intersecting highway where the driver has a view of approaching traffic on the intersecting highway before entering the intersection.

activation.condition: the subject is the driver of a vehicle; the subject is approaching an intersection whose approach is indicated by a stop sign

obligation.description: Every driver of a vehicle approaching a stop intersection indicated by a stop sign shall stop before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection or, if there is no crosswalk, shall stop at a clearly marked stop line, or if none, then at the point nearest the intersecting highway where the driver has a view of approaching traffic on the intersecting highway before entering the intersection.

timing.description: the halt occurs before the footprint crosses the halting reference — the near-side crosswalk, or the stop line if there is no crosswalk, or the point where the view of the intersecting highway opens if there is neither; a full stop, not a rolling minimum: speed at or below the drv.stopped epsilon for at least its span parameter; the halt precedes entering the intersection
